title: Battery Voltage Monitoring
text: Monitor for battery voltage, 2 inputs, 3 outputs, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Undervoltage limit (V)}, {Overvoltage limit (V)}, {Voltage sensor fault threshold (V)} sets the threshold for voltage sensor fault, {Qualification time undervoltage (s)} sets the undervoltage qualification time, {Disqualification time undervoltage (s)} sets the undervoltage disqualification time, {Qualification time overvoltage (s)} sets the overvoltage qualification time, {Disqualification time overvoltage (s)} sets the overvoltage disqualification time, {Qualification time faulty sensor (s)} sets the faulty sensor qualification time, {Disqualification time faulty sensor (s)} sets the faulty sensor disqualification time and {Algorithm data type} sets the option to choose data type for block algorithm. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Voltage sensor fault threshold (V)
params.values: Threshold for voltage sensor fault 0.25 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Qualification time faulty sensor (s)
params.values: Faulty sensor qualification time 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Disqualification time faulty sensor (s)
params.values: Faulty sensor disqualification time 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Algorithm data type
params.values: Option to choose data type for block algorithm Inherit: auto (default) | double | single |
